text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both down roughly 3–4% over the past day, signaling a broader pullback that has pushed the Fear & Greed Index into extreme fear territory and widened that pessimism over the week. Bitcoin dominance at 58.9% suggests capital is rotating defensively into the largest asset rather than flowing into altcoins, while 24-hour volume of $96B remains moderate and consistent with profit-taking rather than panic selling. The combination points to a risk-off mood: traders are cautious but not capitulating, with some stabilization in smaller caps (SOL, BNB down less than 2%) hinting that downside may be limited.
